name: Polycab India Ltd

ledger.quote: We are expecting that plant to get commissioned by the end of next calendar year.
ledger.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
ledger.target: Commission EHV plant by end of next calendar year
ledger.verdict: EHV plant commissioning timeline pushed to FY28.
ledger.evidence: we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.

ledger.quote: We expect this to normalize to our long-term steady range of 50 to 55 days over the coming quarters.
ledger.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya
ledger.verdict: Working capital cycle reported at 11 days in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: average working capital cycle reducing to approximately 11 days in second quarter fiscal '27

ledger.quote: Capital expenditure for the quarter was ₹ 3.4 billion, taking the 9M FY26 total to ₹ 10.9 billion, in-line with our Project Spring guidance of investing ₹ 12 billion to ₹ 16 billion annually through FY30.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: Capex for H1 FY27 incurred at INR 6.1 billion against 5-year target.
ledger.evidence: first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion

ledger.quote: Looking ahead, we are confident in the long-term potential of the FMEG segment and remain on track to achieve our Project Spring targets of 1.5x - 2x industry growth and EBITDA margins in the range of 8% to 10% by FY30
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: FMEG EBIT margin at 10.1% in Q2 FY27 against 8% to 10% FY30 target.
ledger.evidence: recording a 10.1% margin during the quarter

ledger.quote: During Q3 FY26, EPC revenues grew by 4% YoY, reaching ₹ 4,069 million. This quarter, we commenced execution of our existing orders under BharatNet scheme, which is expected to generate ₹ 4.5 billion over the next 3 years for project execution
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: BharatNet order execution ongoing over 3 years.

ledger.quote: Looking ahead, the annual sustainable operating margin is expected to remain in the high single digits over mid- to long term.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: EPC EBIT margin at 7.2% in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: translating into an EBIT margin of 7.2%

ledger.quote: If I had to add to that, to refer to our Project Spring guidance, we've given a long-term guidance of 11% to 13%. But in the near term, yes, what you mentioned is correct.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: Wires and Cables EBIT margin at 14.2% in Q2 FY27 against 11% to 13% guidance.
ledger.evidence: EBIT margins in the Wires and Cables segment stood at 14.2%

ledger.quote: We remain firm on track to achieve our target of greater than 10% contribution from exports by financial year 2030.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: Exports contribution reported at 5% of overall revenues in Q2 FY27 against FY30 target.
ledger.evidence: export contribution is largely attributable to the significant faster growth in the domestic market, which expanded the overall revenue base.

ledger.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the long-term prospects of the FMEG segment. Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: FMEG revenue growth outpaced industry growth in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: marks the 11th consecutive quarter of industry leading growth

ledger.quote: So we have started the execution sometime in last quarter in March. So we can safely say maybe 1/3rd of that should translate into revenue, maybe INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores may come from Bharat Net alone.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: BharatNet and RDSS execution ongoing for the current year.

ledger.quote: And that's one indication that our export growth should be higher than domestic. And we believe if there are no more trade barriers and it's a level playing field, today, we are very well poised to leverage on that growth, and that should reflect in the numbers in the coming quarters.
ledger.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
ledger.verdict: Exports grew 17% YoY while domestic grew 50% YoY in Q2 FY27.
ledger.evidence: domestic Wires and Cables business grew by an impressive 50% year-on-year... sales grew 17% year-on-year

open.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium- to long-term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany

open.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany

open.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range, supported by disciplined project selection, efficient execution, and a healthy order pipeline.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany

open.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany

open.quote: So I think we will continue to operate at this level. We would be happy to operate at a higher end of the guidance that we've given.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany
open.target: operate at higher end of guidance

open.quote: So I would like to take this opportunity to sort of also let the investor community know that in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.
open.speaker: Aditya Nathany

read: Management delivers on short-term working capital targets but misses export growth relative to domestic expansion. Long-term Project Spring targets remain pending.
questions: Why did export growth lag domestic growth at 17% versus 50% in Q2 FY27?
What caused the EHV plant commissioning timeline to slip to FY 2028?
bull: Consolidated revenue grew 52.8% YoY to INR 9899.0 crore in Sep 2026.
FMEG EBIT margins reached 10.1% in Q2 FY27, exceeding initial milestones.
Net cash improved to INR 45.2 billion as of September 30, 2026.
bear: Export growth at 17% lagged domestic Wires and Cables growth of 50% in Q2 FY27.
EHV plant commissioning date delayed from calendar year 2026 to FY2028.
